title: Aloe vera cream for medicinal use
intro: Aloe vera cream is a topical preparation made from the gel-like substance extracted from the leaves of the Aloe barbadensis plant. It is widely used in herbalism for its soothing and healing properties, particularly for skin conditions such as burns, eczema, and psoriasis. The cream contains anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial compounds that help reduce redness, irritation, and infection. It is often applied directly to the skin to promote wound healing and moisturize dry areas. In traditional herbal practices, it is also used to support digestive health when consumed in small amounts.
